commands.summary: decisions/0044-durable-repository-orientation-graph-projection-and-freshness-contract.md binds authority, durable path (rog/manifest.json + nodes/edges/shard-NNNN.jsonl), schema version 1 with fail-closed unknown-major behavior, canonical serialization rules, SHA-256-keyed stable sharding (N=16), the source projection and content-hash fingerprint, manifest-presence-as-capability-signal, the six-state freshness model, and the local-cache boundary (defined, not built).

14/14 tests pass: platform-independent stable physical node IDs, workspace/configuration-file classification, no absolute-path leakage, byte-for-byte repeated full-build determinism, graph self-exclusion from its own source projection, stale-fingerprint detection, graph-disabled compatibility, unknown major schema version rejection, corrupted shard-hash detection, duplicate-node rejection, dangling-edge rejection, and a WI057-equivalent bounded git-invocation-count test (<=4).

49/49 tests pass (46 pre-existing + 3 new): a graph-disabled repository reports zero graph.* diagnostics, a freshly built durable graph validates cleanly through the canonical validate() entry point, and a tampered (unsupported) schema version is surfaced as graph.schema-unsupported by canonical validate().

Full Rust workspace green after fixing a genuine regression caught mid-session: the first draft of SourceProjection::build called Repository::all_files(), which recomputes RepositoryTopology (fresh Git invocations) on every call, breaking repopact-desktop-api's desktop_reads_reuse_one_snapshot_generation_without_git_fanout and watcher_burst_has_one_bounded_refresh_and_ignores_build_churn. Fixed by threading the already-open snapshot's topology through RepositoryGraph::build_with_fingerprint; both tests restored to green.
Canonical Rust validation passes on the live repository (which has no rog/ directory -- graph-disabled, correctly reported as valid with zero graph.* diagnostics).
3/3 new Python CLI tests pass: status on a disabled repository reports absent and exits 0; build then status reports fresh; a source change after build is reported stale via graph verify (exit 1).
